name: paper-excel-to-table
description: Extract structured tables from paper-style form PDFs. PDF rasterization requires macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Convert paper-style form PDFs to structured CSV
interface.longDescription: Rasterizes paper-style form PDFs at high resolution on macOS, extracts structured CSV, and rechecks uncertain cells using image crops. Supports optional YAML schema validation. The Claude Code plugin includes a dedicated extraction subagent.
defaultPrompt: Convert a paper-style form PDF into a structured CSV.
